title: AgriBridge V3 all-India State/UT and District Coverage Register
strategy: All-India parallel catalogue build; grants/subsidies/insurance/benefits and finance/lending routes are tracked as equal workstreams.

geography.caution: The 36 State/UT and 779 district entries are a community-maintained fallback snapshot, not an official LGD-certified current list. District boundaries and counts change. Refresh/reconcile codes and names against the official Local Government Directory before claiming administrative completeness. Block and Gram Panchayat identifiers are not included.

stateInventory.reminder: A State agriculture homepage or district website directory link is not proof that the district's local grants, schemes, PACS and lender branches have been researched.
statesWithNoNamedStateProgrammeRecords: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

financeCoverage.branchVerificationStatus: Institution/product directories are linked; selected-district branch presence, local product availability and live pricing still require institution confirmation.
